name: Slaughter the Strong
oracle_text: Each player chooses any number of creatures they control with total power 4 or less, then sacrifices all other creatures they control.
blocked_sentences: Each player chooses any number of creatures they control with total power 4 or less, then sacrifices all other creatures they control.

needs.what: a per-player choice of any number of permanents matching a selector, constrained so the chosen set's total power is at most N (here 4), bound under a name so a following sacrifice can exclude them (sacrifice all creatures you control except the chosen ones), run for each player in turn order
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_permanents takes only as/objects/prompt with no budget over the chosen set; selector_keys has no total_power and target_keys only total_mana_value (a target budget, and these are not targets); total_power exists only on crew's tap_permanents cost and on cost_reduction, neither of which is a resolution-time choice. A per-creature power <= 4 filter would be a different, wrong card
